Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. We’re looking for a People Systems Manager who’s excited to make an impact by optimizing how our teams access and interact with critical People tools. Drive automation, AI tools, and process improvements that reduce manual work and improve the employee experience. Expand and enhance self-service capabilities for employees and managers, making information easier to find and use. Lead system integrations, workflows, and configuration updates in alignment with business needs. Provide training, support, and guidance to HR team members and internal users. Troubleshoot issues and act as a go-to resource for all things HRIS. What We're Looking For You have deep experience managing and optimizing HR systems, specifically UKG Pro and WFM (required). You bring a strong understanding of HR operations, from hire to retire. You’re tech-savvy and analytical. You love turning data into insights and action. jobs.desc: About Ataraxis AI Ataraxis is a clinical AI research lab working at the intersection of multi-modal AI and precision medicine. Our goal is to make disease predictable. To accomplish this, we develop new AI methods that predict patient outcomes and treatment response, and build clinical tools to assist physicians in selecting the most optimal treatments for their patients. Our AI research lab discovers and develops methods to recognize patterns and predict outcomes across complex, multi-modal clinical data. This spans our causality (Ataraxis™ Tau), foundation model (Falcon and Kestrel for digital pathology), and survival analysis research. Our first clinical products, such as Ataraxis™ Breast for breast cancer, already help patients get the most appropriate treatment across the best academic institutions and community clinics worldwide. At Ataraxis, you will have a unique opportunity to shape not only the future of our company, but also the future of healthcare. You will join an exceptional team at the forefront of clinical AI research and deployment. Our advisors include AI pioneers such as our founding advisor, Yann LeCun, and distinguished oncologists from top cancer research institutions, all united by the mission to redefine precision medicine. Ataraxis has raised over $24 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by top venture capital funds such as Thiel Capital/Founders Fund (OpenAI, SpaceX, Palantir), Obvious Ventures (AMI Labs, Inceptive, Radical Numerics, Recursion), and AIX Ventures (Hugging Face, Perplexity). We are an company with a flat organizational structure, where every team member is empowered to actively contribute. Leadership roles are earned by those who demonstrate initiative and consistently deliver exceptional results. Strong work ethic and the ability to prioritize ruthlessly are essential. Responsibilities Own full-cycle recruiting from sourcing through close Source creatively: competitor mapping, adjacent industries, referrals, and AI-powered tools Build the hiring engine, including interview processes, scorecards, candidate experience, and funnel and time-to-fill reporting Manage outside recruiting partners as needed and help shape how the team grows Qualifications 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting, including in-house at an early-stage or high-growth startup Comfort with technical or research hiring, or a strong desire to learn it A track record of high-volume GTM hiring (e.g. account executives or field sales);

Great people make that work possible, and this role is how we find them, bring them in, and set the teams that hire them up to succeed. In this role, you will do two things. First, you will recruit. You will hire for our mid to lower level roles from intake through offer, and you will build sourcing pipelines in the areas where we hire often, so outreach to strong candidates starts within 24 hours of a role opening. Second, you will run recruiting operations. You will own our applicant tracking system and workflows, use AI agents to take manual steps out of hiring, and help hiring managers and interview teams prepare to hire well. You will also support our other in-house recruiter by taking on parts of recruiting operations for our more senior level hires. Hiring managers will know you as the person to go to for process and recruiting operations help. The pace is fast and the team values people who ask good questions, learn quickly, think ahead, and change course when the situation calls for it. This role reports to the Head of Talent & Culture. What You'll Do Hire end to end. Partner with hiring managers to fill mid to lower level roles from intake through offer, with a clear understanding of each position and the team it supports. Build and maintain AI agent workflows that work well, stay current as technology changes, and reduce manual steps in hiring. Standardize and measure. Keep hiring steps and documents consistent from role to role, and manage our hiring data and dashboard so leaders can see how hiring is going. Support senior-level hiring.
